title: MCDND
description: This is a personal Project for a D&D Campaign in Minecraft
body:
This mod is a project i am putting in a modpack for a personal D&D in Minecraft project.

it adds:
- /money (certain items in your inventory will dissapear if there isnt a barrier in your inventory. these items are: iron nugget, iron ingot, gold nugget, gold ingot, gold block, diamond)
- /enemysummon (gives the ability to summon enemies of multiple difficulty levels)
